boundary.rationale: Extraction area = world agent bbox from cities.js BUC_DISTRICTS (so every street the world builds is covered). 1.11 km N-S × 1.47 km E-W ≈ 1.6 km² trimmed to ~1.3 km² of built area: west edge Calea Floreasca/Gara Herăstrău (Sky Tower, Promenada, Floreasca Park just inside the NW corner), south edge Șos. Fabrica de Glucoză, north edge the Pipera industrial lots / Podul Pipera ramps, east edge Str. George Constantinescu / Conect offices. Contains Hermes Business Campus (luxoft), BOB Tower (DB Global Technology), Novo Park, Globalworth Campus, Pipera metro (M2 terminus).

top_local_details: Bd. Dimitrie Pompeiu is NARROW (1+1 lanes) despite the name — a corporate canyon.
Evening standstill on Pompeiu 17–19:30; everyone leaves at once.
Lift-gate barriers at every office car-park entrance.
Hermes campus: white/grey 9–10-storey blocks around a plaza (north side).
BOB Tower (DB) is a 7-storey glass block on the south side opposite Hermes.
Pipera metro M2 terminus at the east end; buses and taxis around it.
Glass towers everywhere: Globalworth Tower (120 m), AFI Lakeview, Corp A/B (53 m), Marriott (55 m).
Sky Tower at the SW corner (137 m).
Tram 5 on Barbu Văcărescu only; no trams on Pompeiu.
Construction sites/cranes for new offices and residences.
Food trucks and kiosks at lunch, smokers outside lobbies.
Ted's Coffee, ibrik, A•R•C Bakery, Medicover clinic.
Remnant old Pipera industrial halls (JTI factory, Corp 1–20) north of Pompeiu.
Wide new sidewalks in front of new offices, broken ones elsewhere.
Euronet ATMs along Pompeiu.
Bike-share and scooters at the metro.
Raiffeisen HQ and DHL on Barbu Văcărescu.
Șos. Fabrica de Glucoză signed 40 km/h.
12-storey new residential blocks on Fabrica de Glucoză.
Courtyard by Marriott tower on Pompeiu.
Planned widening (tram + bike lanes) — not built yet.
Parking on sidewalks near the metro.
Corporate shuttle minibuses.
Mostly modern LED lamp posts on new sections.
Very few old trees; young planted trees in office plazas.
Security guards in reflective vests directing exits at peak.
Novo Park buildings A–G (5–14 lv) on the south side.
Upground residential/office towers next to BOB.
Globalworth Campus B (13 lv) on George Constantinescu.
Grey sky-reflecting glass dominates the palette.

driving.note: RO:urban default 50; several boulevards signed 60 (OSM maxspeed=60 on Lascăr Catargiu, Magheru, Dorobanți north).

markings.lane_line: white dashed 3 m line / 6 m gap on urban roads (RO standard SR 1848-7), 0.10–0.15 m wide
markings.centre_line: white continuous (single) on 2-lane two-way, double continuous on 4+ lane two-way without median
markings.zebra: white bars 0.5 m wide / 0.5 m gap, parallel to traffic, no side lines; a few school-zone crossings have red infill between the white bars (verify per crossing on refs)
markings.bus_lane: white continuous line with "BUS" text; since 2019 some STB lanes on Magheru axis/Ștefan cel Mare painted red-brown (#9E3B2E) – verify per street
markings.yellow: yellow only for temporary works and kerb no-parking (zig-zag at bus stops)
markings.wear: markings visibly worn/faded on most streets except freshly resurfaced arteries — use 60–80% opacity

kerbs.material: grey concrete kerbstones 15×25 cm (older streets: granite #8C8C8C), kerb height 12–18 cm, often chipped

sidewalks.paving: mix: (a) grey concrete interlocking pavers ("pavele") #A9A59C on renovated boulevards; (b) cracked asphalt #6E6C68 on side streets; (c) 40×40 grey concrete slabs on 1960–80s estates
sidewalks.parking_on_sidewalk: very common: cars half/fully on the sidewalk on side streets, behind metal bollards on boulevards

traffic_lights.model: RO 3-aspect vehicle heads (200/300 mm), black or yellow housing with yellow-black backplates on main arteries, mounted on grey/black poles + overhead mast arms at big junctions; pedestrian 2-aspect (red/green man) with countdown displays on major junctions

street_name_plates.style: blue plate (#1F4E9A) white text "Bulevardul X" + sector number "Sector 1" in smaller text, on building corners or poles

bus_shelter.style: STB/Clear-channel style glass shelters with grey steel frame and backlit ad panel; many stops have only a pole with the yellow STB stop sign + timetable

metro_totem.style: Metrorex entrance: blue square sign with white "M", station name in white on blue; stairs down with grey stone/steel railings

trolleybus_wires.style: pair of copper contact wires 0.6 m apart per direction at ~5.6 m, carried by span wires between steel or concrete poles on both kerbs (often shared with street lamps)

tram_track.style: standard gauge 1435 mm; on boulevards in a central reservation with concrete sleepers/ballast or grass, kerbed and fenced in places; overhead single contact wire on span wires

lamps.boulevard: galvanised/grey steel octagonal poles 10–12 m, single or double arm, LED or older sodium cobra heads (sodium = orange #FFB45A; LED = 4000 K white #F2F0E6); 25–35 m spacing staggered on both kerbs and often in the median
lamps.side_street: 7–9 m grey poles or concrete poles with single arm, ~30 m spacing

dialogue.format: Each line {text (original language), en (English)}; persona.lang = language of text; `base` refers to bucharest-spots.json dialogue_general.persona_library; categories greeting / bumped / photographed / idle / district (place-specific facts, all consistent with this dossier).

personas.name: Irina (QA engineer, Hermes campus)
personas.desc: Corporate employee with a badge and coffee cup; mixes Romanian with English office jargon.

greeting.text: Salut, mergi și tu spre metrou?
greeting.en: Hi, heading to the metro too?

photographed.en: Wait, let me hide my badge.

photographed.text: Fă una cu Hermes în spate.

idle.text: Am call cu echipa din India la zece.
idle.en: Call with the team in India at ten.

district.text: Pe Dimitrie Pompeiu stai o oră seara.
district.en: You sit for an hour on Dimitrie Pompeiu in the evening.

district.text: Vin cu metroul, e singura variantă sigură.
district.en: I come by metro, it's the only reliable option.

district.text: Barierele de la parcări blochează tot bulevardul.
district.en: The car-park barriers block the whole boulevard.

district.text: Au promis că lărgesc bulevardul, mai vedem.
district.en: They promised to widen the boulevard, we'll see.

personas.name: Domnul Gelu (office security)
personas.desc: Security guard in a reflective vest controlling the barrier at an office car park.

greeting.en: Good day, do you have access?

bumped.text: Nu pe aici, intrarea e în stânga.
bumped.en: Not this way, the entrance is on the left.

photographed.text: Nu e voie cu poze în incintă.
Fotografiați de pe trotuar, vă rog.
photographed.en: Please take pictures from the sidewalk.

photographed.text: Bine, dar fără clădirea pe dinăuntru.
photographed.en: Fine, but not the inside of the building.

idle.text: La cinci iese toată lumea deodată.
idle.en: At five everyone leaves at once.

district.en: Couriers leave parcels at the gate.

district.text: Seara fac eu semn mașinilor să iasă pe Pompeiu.
district.en: In the evening I wave the cars out onto Pompeiu.

district.text: Metroul Pipera e la două minute.
district.en: Pipera metro is two minutes away.

personas.name: Marian (food-delivery courier)
personas.desc: Bike/scooter courier with an insulated backpack, delivering lunches to the office towers.

greeting.en: Where's entrance B, do you know?

bumped.text: Scuze, mă grăbesc, am trei comenzi!
bumped.en: Sorry, in a hurry, three orders!

photographed.en: No, no, I'm on a run!
OK, but give me five stars!

idle.text: Cu trotineta ajung mai repede ca mașinile.
idle.en: On the scooter I beat the cars.

district.text: Pe Pompeiu trec printre mașini, că stau toate.
district.en: On Pompeiu I squeeze between the cars, they're all standing still.
Every building has a different reception.

district.text: Globalworth e cel mai înalt de aici.

district.en: In the evening I deliver in Floreasca.

personas.name: Sorin (Pipera metro commuter)
personas.desc: Commuter coming out of the M2 terminus at Pipera every morning.

bumped.en: We all come out of the metro at once...

photographed.en: What, am I on the news?

photographed.text: Fă poză la coadă la autobuz.

idle.text: M2 a mers bine azi, ciudat.
idle.en: The M2 ran fine today, strange.

idle.text: Mai am o oră de proiect înainte de ședință.
idle.en: One hour of project work before the meeting.
I work from home on Fridays.

district.text: Pipera e capăt de linie la M2.
district.en: Pipera is the end of the line on the M2.

district.text: Cu mașina nu mai vin de mult.
district.en: I stopped coming by car long ago.

district.text: Pe vremuri aici erau fabrici și câmp.
district.en: This used to be factories and fields.

district.text: Autobuzele spre Voluntari pleacă de aici.
district.en: Buses to Voluntari leave from here.

culture_notes.note: "Bună ziua" with strangers, "Salut/Neața" among young people; "dumneavoastră" (formal you) to older people; "Mersi" is as common as "Mulțumesc".
Bucharest drivers honk readily and often do not stop at zebras; pedestrians answer with sarcasm rather than aggression — keep lines teasing, not violent.
Cars parked on sidewalks are a constant pedestrian complaint; a natural topic for bumped/idle lines in side streets.
At OTP passengers order licensed taxis from touch-screen kiosks in Arrivals; unsolicited offers are a known nuisance — staff lines should point to the kiosks.
Personas are defined by role/place (student, vendor, commuter), never by ethnicity; Roma, Moldovan or diaspora characters are not caricatured; humour targets traffic, weather, parking and the metro.

Generic personas (local_elder, tour_guide …) and the pedestrian_general set (honked_at, near_miss, sidewalk_parking) live in bucharest-spots.json → dialogue_general; district personas below add place-specific lines.
